summary: Iteration 12: Dashboard Edit Mode bug fix verified. The 'can't move anything' bug has been FIXED. All edit mode features (drag, scale, rotate, save, reset, cancel) are working correctly. The root cause was CSS transform string generating 'scale(undefined) rotate(undefineddeg)' when widget transform lacked default values - fixed by spreading defaults in EditableWidget.jsx line 8.

features_verified.feature: Dashboard Edit Mode - Drag Functionality (BUG FIX)
features_verified.details: The 'can't move anything' bug is FIXED. Root cause was CSS transform string 'scale(undefined) rotate(undefineddeg)' when widget transform lacked default values. Fix in EditableWidget.jsx line 8: `const t = { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rotation: 0, ...(transform || {}) }` ensures CSS transform always has valid values.
Scale handle (blue, bottom-right corner) works correctly. Dragging outward scales widget up (tested: 1.0 -> 1.32).
Rotate buttons (purple, top-right corner) work correctly. Each click rotates widget 15 degrees.
All three buttons work: Save persists to localStorage, Reset returns to defaults, Cancel reverts session changes.
Layout changes persist across page reloads via localStorage (key: 'frank-dash-layout').

critical_code_review_comments: EditableWidget.jsx line 8: Key bug fix - `const t = { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rotation: 0, ...(transform || {}) }` ensures CSS transform always has valid values
EditableWidget.jsx: Uses window-level event listeners for drag/scale to handle mouse leaving element bounds
EditableWidget.jsx: Touch events supported for Raspberry Pi touchscreen use
useLayoutStore.js: updateWidget saves partial transforms (may only have x,y without scale/rotation) - this is why defaults are needed in EditableWidget
Dashboard.jsx: preEditLayout state correctly captures layout before edit mode for cancel functionality
All data-testid attributes correctly implemented for testing
